title: Forever market value for one item
description: Returns the market value, minimum buyout, historical value and units listed for one item on one WoW: Forever realm, from full auction scans players started and uploaded. A day is public after 3 reporters (distinct upload addresses) scanned the item, or, while few players upload, when Everloot's own installs did, and its reporters say so; its value is the median of theirs. Market value is a weighted mean of the public days up to 14 calendar days old, newer days weighing more, leaving out thin days (5 units listed or fewer) and outlier days. Historical is the median of the public days in the last 60 calendar days, of the days that are not thin when there are any. Use it for what an item is worth now; use auction_history for the price over time, and vendor_page for vendor prices. The realm is its full name as the game's realm list shows it. A name that is the end of exactly one realm's full name is read as that realm, and the answer says so; a name that ends several, or none, answers ambiguous or unknown with the realms to ask with, never an empty market. Reads Everloot's public player data when connected. Missing or unavailable data is reported explicitly.

realm.description: The realm's full name as the game's realm list shows it, such as CAMWOW US1 Realm 4 PvP. The end of exactly one realm's full name (US1 Realm 4 PvP) is read as that realm; an unknown or ambiguous name answers with the realms to ask with.

itemId.description: The game's item id, as item_page takes it.

connected.description: False when no corpus was read; the page is then absent, which is not a measured zero.

dataAsOf.description: The corpus snapshot time, or null when unrecorded.

reason.description: Why nothing was read, when connected is false.

url.description: The everloot.app page that shows this answer, absolute. Absent when there is no such page or it would be empty.

market.description: Null when no solid public day falls in the last 14: unrecorded, not zero.

value.description: Null until 3 reporters scanned the item on the realm, or one of Everloot's own installs did, and for an ambiguous or unknown realm.

realmStatus.description: exact: a realm Everloot holds scans for. alias: the end of exactly one public realm's full name, read as that realm (realm is its full name). ambiguous: the end of several realms' names, so nothing is read. unknown: no scan names that realm, so nothing is read; that is not an empty market.

askedRealm.description: The realm as asked, when it was read as an alias.

candidates.description: For ambiguous or unknown: the realms with public prices to ask with instead, closest first.
